searchText: Is there a way of querying all blob transactions related to a rollup? Like namespaces on Celestia this is impossible if different rollups share the same blob. For larger rollups you can just look at transactions sent by their batch poster address which is public Oh I see Tristan mentioned looking at the target address instead of the originating one, for Arbitrum that would be better than what I posted, not sure if this would work for other rollups though Got it. But I assume both methods doesn’t ensure that all blobs are captured, does it? in the case of Arbitrum you'll catch all
